result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the 90-day LOC instead of the 180-day LOC.

**Change:** In `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary` (around line 906), the `past 90d` info block was formatting `loc180Days` for its LOC value. It now uses `loc90Days`, matching its repository count and percentage.

**Verification:** `mvn -q -o -pl reports compile` succeeds. The reports module has no landscape tests, so I did not run a test class and did not check the rendered report. I did not commit.
